title: Cadence restart resets on EVERY post-correction batch — co_nudge and reminders mislabeled as invitation_sent
detail: The reset condition (norm_at > corrected_ts AND batch_index > 0) is true for every batch after the correction, not just the first. After the reset, the accumulator is 1, so the next batch again matches Gt && batch_index > 0 → cycle_index 0 again. Post-correction co_nudge/reminders all become invitation_sent, ordinals never emitted — AC1 fails for corrected rows.
recommended_fix: Reset once: track a `restarted` flag (or compare against the previous batch's at), so only the first batch strictly after corrected_at restarts the cadence; subsequent batches continue co_nudge/reminder labeling.
